source: Aungier, R. H., Axial-Flow Compressors (ASME Press, 2003), Ch. 5, Fig. 5-15 'Boundary Layer Analysis Result', printed p. 113: NACA 65(12A10)-10, alpha = 12 deg, beta_in = 45 deg, M_in = 0.65; boundary-layer shape factor H = delta*/theta (Eq. 5-129) on the suction and pressure surfaces vs x/c, edge conditions from the potential-flow solution of Fig. 5-6
method: digitized from the PDF's embedded raster (1057 x 801 px) by tools/turbolenza_reference digitization: axes calibrated on the 11 x and 6 y tick marks (least squares); the plotted curves are polylines, so their vertices are taken: near the LE as intersections of straight-line fits through the line centres, the transition points as the centres of the transition dots, downstream of transition by Douglas-Peucker simplification (1.0 px) of the column-scanned line centres
note: H on the suction surface after separation_start is the dashed part (separated, H_k limited, Aungier p. 111); the LE segments before transition are laminar (Gruschwitz), after transition turbulent (Head / Green)
